messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then turns his body to the right, looks over his shoulder, and finally faces forward again.","camera":"The camera orbits around the character from a front view to a side profile, then to a rear view, and back to the front, maintaining a medium full shot.","clothing":"A dark blue, long-sleeved military-style uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, a gold belt, and matching dark blue trousers and black shoes.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with dark skin, a slim build, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit courtyard with cracked stone paving, surrounded by weathered, tan-colored buildings with wooden structures and debris."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a dark neon sci-fi plaza to a bright outdoor courtyard with cracked stone paving, tan buildings, wooden debris, and pipes, closely matching the reference. The character remains a dark-skinned 3D male with white hair and a similar military uniform, and the orbiting camera and standing/turning action are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the futuristic neon environment with the sunlit ruined courtyard from the reference, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, with natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved exactly, since the face is small and partly obscured in several frames.
unexpected_changes: The uniform appears more blue-gray in the output than the dark purple/maroon tone in the source, likely due to the new daylight lighting.
